notes:
What's new in DuckOS 1.0.74

• DuckAI answers: Duckling reads its whole prompt once in the background right after it wakes up, so a question gets its first words in seconds instead of minutes. While it reads, DuckAI says so, with the seconds; if it ever takes too long or stops, it says that too instead of staying silent.
• DuckWallet 3.0.4: a card saved while DuckOS's wallet couldn't be reached is moved into it the next time DuckWallet opens, so DuckPay (double-press the power button) has every card.
• Settings › DuckCloud: the "Delete everything in DuckCloud" button is gone.
